integrity: The rank-reversal criterion follows algebraically from exact monotone reparameterizations of Jaccard and Simpson similarity. A separate standard-library verifier checks the criterion on every normalized Venn signature through gamma richness eight, exhaustively establishes the sharp boundary through four species, and replays the infinite witness family with exact fractions.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to pairwise species presence–absence data and the turnover-oriented Simpson similarity complementary to beta_sim. The finite boundary classifies Venn-count signatures rather than joint isomorphism types of four communities, and it does not address abundance-weighted beta diversity.
title: Jaccard–Simpson species similarity first reverses at four species
